name: WhatsApp
description: Send and receive WhatsApp messages via WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API). Manage sessions, send text/media, and handle incoming messages. Account linking is always done with a numeric pairing code (request-pairing-code) — QR authentication is not supported.
tagline: Send and receive WhatsApp messages, manage sessions, and share media via WAHA

auth.instructions: This app connects through the agent. Ask in the chat to link your WhatsApp session: you will get a pairing code to enter in WhatsApp > Linked Devices > Link with phone number. You can also ask the agent to check the session status or disconnect.
